_comment: Show-level config plus the episode list. Episode `id` is the mp3 filename AND the permanent RSS guid — never rename a published episode. `order` sets play order in the feed. See AUDIO_SCRIPT_AUTHORING.md.

show.title: Morning Recall
show.description: Narrated system design and technology decisions, derived from the morning-recall prep guides. Personal study notes, read aloud.
show.author: Jaspreet Singh

episodes.title: Ticketmaster, part one — the inverse of a scale problem
episodes.summary: Why a stadium onsale is a contention problem, not a scale problem: sixty thousand total sales, a hundred and sixty-six people per seat, and the numbers done at three levels.

episodes.title: Ticketmaster, part two — the hold, and concurrency at a hundred and sixty-six to one
episodes.summary: Three wrong ways to expire a hold, why lazy expiration beats all of them, and the one SQL clause that turns a serialization bottleneck into parallel work.

episodes.title: Figma — why not O.T., and what last-write-wins costs
episodes.summary: Why Operational Transformation is the wrong machinery for a map of objects, and the three costs of last-writer-wins with a central ordering authority.

episodes.title: Correctness under concurrency — the invariant, the fencing token, and write skew
Push notifications — the hint, not the truth
Estimation — the four-line model, and the conclusion the numbers force
